newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover plunged to 760 million yuan from 1.911 billion yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Trading was sluggish mainly because state banks stayed on the sidelines due to ample money reserves, traders said.
"State-run banks have ample money supply in recent months due to surging bank deposits," one trader said. "They have become reluctant to trade on the market."
One banking source estimated China's bank deposits had hit more than five trillion yuan against around four trillion by the end of last year.
Traders said they believed the rates would continue to move narrowly around the current level in the short term.
